scripts.title: Part 1 | Instant Unlock Code
scripts.features: So basically this code only works in Part 1 and when you execute it, it automatically enters the code in the elevator lock and unlocks the code lock (open source)
scripts.script:
--Insta code
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local digitsLabel = Workspace:WaitForChild("monochrome"):WaitForChild("CodeNote"):WaitForChild("Printed"):WaitForChild("Digits")
local keypadFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("monochrome"):WaitForChild("Keypad")

local cleanCode = string.gsub(digitsLabel.Text, "%D", "")

if #cleanCode == 4 then
	task.wait(0.5)

	for index = 1, 4 do
		local digitValue = tonumber(string.sub(cleanCode, index, index))
		local digitPart = keypadFolder:FindFirstChild("Digit" .. index)

		if digitPart then
			local clickDetector = digitPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
			if clickDetector then
				for i = 1, digitValue do
					fireclickdetector(clickDetector)
					task.wait(0.15)
				end
			end
		end

		task.wait(0.4)
	end
end

scripts.title: Auto Solve, ESP, Remove VHS
scripts.features:
**This script does not redirect you to sites like Linkvertise; it simply requires a single, permanent key from Discord that everyone can use. Enjoy.**

**Reader**

Live Elevator Code Reader — reads the code note in real time.
Displays the current elevator/keypad code.
Copy Elevator Code button.

**Automation**

Auto Solve Keypad — automatically enters the 4-digit code into the keypad.
Instant Proximity Prompts — removes hold duration from proximity prompts.
Auto Open Drawers — opens nearby unopened drawers.
Auto Pry Planks — automatically pries blocked planks.

**ESP**

Monster ESP — box + distance tracking for the monster.
Escape Keys ESP — highlights escape keys.
Code Note ESP — highlights the code note.
Hiding Closets ESP — highlights hiding closets.
Unopened Drawers ESP — highlights unopened drawers.
Clear All ESP button.

**Visuals**

Fullbright — removes darkness/fog and improves visibility.
Remove Screen Grain / VHS — disables grain and VHS post-effects.

scripts.script:
-- MONOCROMA HUB
local P=game:GetService("Players")
local L=game:GetService("Lighting")
local R=game:GetService("RunService")
local U=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local T=game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TS=game:GetService("TweenService")
local CS=game:GetService("CollectionService")
local plr=P.LocalPlayer
local pg=plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old=pg:FindFirstChild("MonocromaHub")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local C={
 bg=Color3.fromRGB(10,10,12),panel=Color3.fromRGB(17,17,20),
 el=Color3.fromRGB(25,25,29),hover=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,40),
 white=Color3.fromRGB(240,240,240),gray=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,155),
 green=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,100),red=Color3.fromRGB(255,65,65)
}

local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui",pg)
gui.Name="MonocromaHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

local main=Instance.new("Frame",gui)
main.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(600,390)
main.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-300,.5,-195)
main.BackgroundColor3=C.bg
main.BorderSizePixel=0
main.Active=true
Instance.new("UICorner",main).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)

local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke",main)
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(48,48,53)

local head=Instance.new("Frame",main)
head.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,55)
head.BackgroundColor3=C.panel
head.BorderSizePixel=0

local title=Instance.new("TextLabel",head)
title.BackgroundTransparency=1
title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(17,7)
title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-140,0,25)
title.Text="MONOCROMA"
title.TextColor3=C.white
title.TextSize=18
title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local sub=Instance.new("TextLabel",head)
sub.BackgroundTransparency=1
sub.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,31)
sub.Size=UDim2.new(1,-140,0,16)
sub.Text="Universal Hub"
sub.TextColor3=C.gray
sub.TextSize=10
sub.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham

local min=Instance.new("TextButton",head)
min.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,30)
min.Position=UDim2.new(1,-80,0,12)
min.Text="—"
min.TextColor3=C.white
min.TextSize=18
min.BackgroundColor3=C.el
Instance.new("UICorner",min).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7)

local close=Instance.new("TextButton",head)
close.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,30)
close.Position=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,12)
close.Text="×"
close.TextColor3=C.red
close.TextSize=20
close.BackgroundColor3=C.el
Instance.new("UICorner",close).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7)

local side=Instance.new("Frame",main)
side.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,55)
side.Size=UDim2.new(0,140,1,-55)
side.BackgroundColor3=C.panel
side.BorderSizePixel=0

local pad=Instance.new("UIPadding",side)
pad.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,15)
pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8)
pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)

local sl=Instance.new("UIListLayout",side)
sl.Padding=UDim.new(0,7)

local content=Instance.new("Frame",main)
content.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(140,55)
content.Size=UDim2.new(1,-140,1,-55)
content.BackgroundTransparency=1

local pages={}
local tabs={}

local function page(n)
    local f=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame",content)
    f.Name=n
    f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12)
    f.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24)
    f.BackgroundTransparency=1
    f.BorderSizePixel=0
    f.ScrollBarThickness=3
    f.ScrollBarImageColor3=C.green
    f.Visible=false

    local l=Instance.new("UIListLayout",f)
    l.Padding=UDim.new(0,8)

    l:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        f.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,l.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+15)
    end)

    pages[n]=f
    return f
end

local visual=page("Visual")
local playerPage=page("Player")
local teleport=page("Teleport")

local function tab(txt,n)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton",side)
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,38)
    b.BackgroundColor3=C.panel
    b.Text=txt
    b.TextColor3=C.gray
    b.TextSize=12
    b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    b.AutoButtonColor=false
    Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)

    tabs[n]=b

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for k,v in pairs(pages) do
            v.Visible=false
            tabs[k].BackgroundColor3=C.panel
            tabs[k].TextColor3=C.gray
        end

        pages[n].Visible=true
        b.BackgroundColor3=C.el
        b.TextColor3=C.green
    end)
end

tab("◈  Visual","Visual")
tab("◉  Player","Player")
tab("⌖  Teleport","Teleport")

local function section(p,txt)
    local x=Instance.new("TextLabel",p)
    x.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,27)
    x.BackgroundTransparency=1
    x.Text=txt
    x.TextColor3=C.green
    x.TextSize=13
    x.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    x.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
end

local function button(p,txt,fn)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton",p)
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,43)
    b.BackgroundColor3=C.el
    b.Text=txt
    b.TextColor3=C.white
    b.TextSize=13
    b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    b.AutoButtonColor=false
    Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)

    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        b.BackgroundColor3=C.hover
    end)

    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        b.BackgroundColor3=C.el
    end)

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fn)
    return b
end

local function toggle(p,txt,fn)
    local b=button(p,txt.."  [OFF]",function() end)
    local on=false

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on=not on
        b.Text=txt.."  ["..(on and "ON" or "OFF").."]"
        fn(on)
    end)

    return b
end

--==================================================
-- VISUAL
--==================================================

section(visual,"VISUAL")

local night
local oldClock,oldBright

toggle(visual,"Vision nocturna",function(on)
    if on then
        oldClock=L.ClockTime
        oldBright=L.Brightness

        night=Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect",L)
        night.Name="MonocromaNight"
        night.TintColor=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,80)
        night.Brightness=.15

        L.ClockTime=0
        L.Brightness=3
    else
        if night then night:Destroy() end
        night=nil

        L.ClockTime=oldClock or 14
        L.Brightness=oldBright or 1
    end
end)

local walls={}

toggle(visual,"Ver paredes",function(on)
    for _,p in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("SeeThroughWall")) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            if on then
                walls[p]=p.LocalTransparencyModifier
                p.LocalTransparencyModifier=.85
            elseif walls[p] then
                p.LocalTransparencyModifier=walls[p]
                walls[p]=nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- KEY ESP
--==================================================

local keyESP=false
local keyObjects={}

local function clearKeys()
    for _,x in ipairs(keyObjects) do
        if x then x:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(keyObjects)
end

local function getPart(o)
    if o:IsA("BasePart") then
        return o
    end

    if o:IsA("Model") then
        return o.PrimaryPart
            or o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
    end
end

local function updateKeys()
    clearKeys()
    if not keyESP then return end

    local n=0

    for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if o.Name:lower()=="key"
        and (o:IsA("Model") or o:IsA("BasePart")) then

            n+=1

            local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
            h.Adornee=o
            h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,0)
            h.OutlineColor=C.white
            h.FillTransparency=.45
            table.insert(keyObjects,h)

            local p=getPart(o)

            if p then
                local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                bb.Adornee=p
                bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(130,35)
                bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                bb.MaxDistance=2000

                local t=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                t.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                t.BackgroundTransparency=1
                t.Text="KEY "..n
                t.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,50)
                t.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                t.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                t.TextSize=16
                t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold

                table.insert(keyObjects,bb)
            end
        end
    end
end

toggle(visual,"Key ESP",function(on)
    keyESP=on
    updateKeys()
end)

--==================================================
-- POLE / SCREWDRIVER ESP
--==================================================

local itemESP=false
local itemObjects={}

local function clearItems()
    for _,x in ipairs(itemObjects) do
        if x then x:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(itemObjects)
end

local function isRealItem(o)
    if not (o:IsA("Model") or o:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return false
    end

    local n=o.Name:lower()

    return n=="pole" or n=="screwdriver"
end

local function updateItems()
    clearItems()
    if not itemESP then return end

    local detected={}

    for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if isRealItem(o) then
            local p=getPart(o)

            if p then
                local duplicate=false

                for _,d in ipairs(detected) do
                    if o:IsDescendantOf(d) or d:IsDescendantOf(o) then
                        duplicate=true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not duplicate then
                    table.insert(detected,o)

                    local name=o.Name:lower()=="pole"
                        and "POLE"
                        or "SCREWDRIVER"

                    local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
                    h.Adornee=o
                    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,120)
                    h.OutlineColor=C.white
                    h.FillTransparency=.45
                    table.insert(itemObjects,h)

                    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                    bb.Adornee=p
                    bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,35)
                    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                    bb.MaxDistance=2000
                    bb.Parent=gui
                    table.insert(itemObjects,bb)

                    local text=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                    text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    text.Text=name
                    text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
                    text.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                    text.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                    text.TextSize=15
                    text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

toggle(visual,"Pole / Screwdriver ESP",function(on)
    itemESP=on
    updateItems()
end)

--==================================================
-- ESP VER (MONOCROMA)
--==================================================

local verESP=false
local verObjects={}

local function clearVER()
    for _,v in ipairs(verObjects) do
        if v then v:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(verObjects)
end

local function updateVER()
    clearVER()
    if not verESP then return end

    local detected={}

    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then

            local n=obj.Name:lower()
            local isVER=(n=="ver")
            local isMonster=n=="monster" or n:match("^monster[%w_%.%-]*$")~=nil

            local hum=obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root=obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local moving=false

            if hum and root then
                moving=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>2
            end

            if isVER or (isMonster and moving) then
                local part=getPart(obj)

                if part and not detected[obj] then
                    detected[obj]=true

                    local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
                    h.Adornee=obj
                    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,40,40)
                    h.OutlineColor=C.white
                    h.FillTransparency=.35
                    table.insert(verObjects,h)

                    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                    bb.Adornee=part
                    bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(180,38)
                    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                    bb.MaxDistance=2500
                    bb.Parent=gui
                    table.insert(verObjects,bb)

                    local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                    txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    txt.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    txt.Text=isVER and "VER" or "MOVING MONSTER"
                    txt.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
                    txt.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                    txt.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                    txt.TextSize=16
                    txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

toggle(visual,"ESP VER (Monocroma)",function(on)
    verESP=on
    updateVER()
end)

-- ACTUALIZACIÓN DE ESP
task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent do
        if keyESP then
            updateKeys()
        end

        if itemESP then
            updateItems()
        end

        if verESP then
            updateVER()
        end

        task.wait(.5)
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER
--==================================================

section(playerPage,"PLAYER")

local speed=16
local speedBtn

speedBtn=button(playerPage,"Velocidad  •  16",function()
    speed+=8

    if speed>64 then
        speed=16
    end

    speedBtn.Text="Velocidad  •  "..speed

    local h=plr.Character and
        plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if h then
        h.WalkSpeed=speed
    end
end)

plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
    local h=c:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)

    if h then
        h.WalkSpeed=speed
    end
end)

local noclip=false
local oldCol={}

toggle(playerPage,"No Clip",function(on)
    noclip=on

    if not on then
        for p,v in pairs(oldCol) do
            if p.Parent then
                p.CanCollide=v
            end
        end

        table.clear(oldCol)
    end
end)

R.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not noclip then return end

    local c=plr.Character
    if not c then return end

    for _,p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            if oldCol[p]==nil then
                oldCol[p]=p.CanCollide
            end

            p.CanCollide=false
        end
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- TELEPORT
--==================================================

section(teleport,"TELEPORT")

local saved

button(teleport,"TP1  •  GUARDAR POSICIÓN",function()
    local r=plr.Character and
        plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if r then
        saved=r.CFrame
    end
end)

button(teleport,"TP2  •  IR A POSICIÓN",function()
    local r=plr.Character and
        plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if r and saved then
        r.CFrame=saved+Vector3.new(0,2,0)
    end
end)

button(teleport,"↩  RETURN TO LOBBY",function()
    T:Teleport(134208374070897,plr)
end)

--==================================================
-- TAB INICIAL
--==================================================

visual.Visible=true
tabs.Visual.BackgroundColor3=C.el
tabs.Visual.TextColor3=C.green

--==================================================
-- DRAG
--==================================================

local dragging=false
local dragStart,startPos

head.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging=true
        dragStart=i.Position
        startPos=main.Position
    end
end)

U.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if dragging and (
        i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local d=i.Position-dragStart

        main.Position=UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset+d.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y
        )
    end
end)

U.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging=false
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZAR
--==================================================

local minimized=false

min.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized=not minimized

    side.Visible=not minimized
    content.Visible=not minimized

    TS:Create(main,TweenInfo.new(.2),{
        Size=minimized
            and UDim2.fromOffset(600,55)
            or UDim2.fromOffset(600,390)
    }):Play()

    min.Text=minimized and "+" or "—"
end)

--==================================================
-- CERRAR
--==================================================

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    gui:Destroy()
end)

--==================================================
-- ANIMACIÓN
--==================================================

main.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)

TS:Create(
    main,
    TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
    {Size=UDim2.fromOffset(600,390)}
):Play()

print("MONOCROMA HUB cargado")

scripts.features:
✨ [FEATURES] ✨

🏃 1. Movement & Physics: ⚡

💨 Custom Speedhack: 🏃‍♂️ Freely adjust your walk speed with a smooth slider (16
– 120 studs).

👻 True Noclip: 🧱 Instantly disables character collision to freely walk through
walls and doors.

🕊️ Smooth Fly Mode: 🛸 Controllable flight using standard keys
(W/A/S/D/Space/Shift) with a dedicated fly speed slider.

🛡️ 2. Anti-VER Defense & Radar: 🚨

🔮 Forcefield (Anti-VER Repel): 💥 Physical forcefield — automatically propels
your character away from the monster whenever it gets too close! 🚫

🧭 Circular VER Radar Widget: 🎯 Sleek circular screen radar with dynamic threat
levels:

🔴 DANGER! (< 15 m) ⚠️

🟡 WARNING (15 – 35 m) ⚡

🟣 SAFE (> 35 m) 🛡️

📏 Real-time distance measurement to the monster in meters.

👁️ 3. Visuals, ESP & Tracers: 🌟

👹 Monster ESP (VER): 🔴 Vibrant 3D highlight visible through any walls and
obstacles.

🔑 All Keys ESP: 🟡 Outlines all objective keys (1–4) and hidden items across the
map.

🚪 Closet & Locker ESP: 🟢 Highlights nearby closets and safe hiding spots.

📏 Distance ESP: 📐 Displays the exact distance in meters to every highlighted
object.

🎯 Advanced Tracers: ⚡ Smooth Drawing API snaplines directed towards VER and key
objectives.

☀️ Fullbright: 💡 Completely removes darkness and floods the map with clear,
bright lighting.

🌫️ No Fog & No Static: 🚫 Strips away dense fog and disables pixel screen
static/grain overlays.

🔭 Custom FOV: 🎚️ Adjustable Field of View slider (ranging from 60 to 120).

📍 4. Teleports Tab (Noclip Protected): 🚀

🗝️ Keys 1–4 Teleport: ⚡ Teleport straight to any numbered key with instant
automatic pickup! 🎒

📝 Code Note Teleport: 📄 Warp directly to the note containing the door code.

🔢 Keypad Teleport: 🚪 Jump right in front of the door keypad lock.

📦 Nearest Closet Teleport: 🏃‍♂️ Emergency teleport into the closest available
locker when danger approaches.

local ActiveESP = { highlights = {}, billboards = {}, boxes = {} }

local function ClearAllESP()
    for _, h in ipairs(ActiveESP.highlights) do pcall(function() h:Destroy() end) end
    for _, b in ipairs(ActiveESP.billboards) do pcall(function() b.gui:Destroy() end) end
    for _, data in ipairs(ActiveESP.boxes) do if data.box then pcall(function() data.box:Destroy() end) end end
    ActiveESP = { highlights = {}, billboards = {}, boxes = {} }
end

local function CreateHighlightESP(object, info)
    if not object or not object:IsA("BasePart") then return end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.FillColor = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    highlight.OutlineColor = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Adornee = object
    highlight.Parent = object

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Adornee = object
    billboard.Parent = object

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.Parent = billboard

    if info.type == "code" then label.Text = getLoc("code")
    elseif info.type == "spawn" then label.Text = getLoc("spawn") end

    if info.type ~= "spawn" and not CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT then
        billboard.Enabled = false
    end

    table.insert(ActiveESP.highlights, highlight)
    table.insert(ActiveESP.billboards, { gui = billboard, label = label, info = info })
end

local function CreateBoxESP(target, info)
    if not target then return end
    
    local adornTarget = target
    if target:IsA("Folder") then
        adornTarget = target:FindFirstChild("Key") or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
    if not adornTarget or (not adornTarget:IsA("Model") and not adornTarget:IsA("BasePart")) then return end

    for _, data in ipairs(ActiveESP.boxes) do 
        if data.box and data.box.Adornee == adornTarget then return end 
    end

    local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    box.Name = (info and info.type == "monster") and "MonsterESP_Box" or "KeyESP_Box"
    box.Adornee = adornTarget
    box.AlwaysOnTop = true
    box.ZIndex = 5
    box.Transparency = 0.5
    box.Color3 = (info and info.type == "monster") and CONFIG.MONSTER_COLOR or CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
    
    if adornTarget:IsA("Model") then
        box.Size = adornTarget:GetExtentsSize()
    else
        box.Size = adornTarget.Size
    end
    box.Parent = adornTarget
    table.insert(ActiveESP.boxes, {box = box, info = info})

    if info and info.type == "key" then
        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Adornee = adornTarget
        billboard.Parent = adornTarget

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.TextColor3 = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextScaled = true
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.Text = getLoc("key") .. " " .. info.id
        label.Parent = billboard

        if not CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT then
            billboard.Enabled = false
        end

        table.insert(ActiveESP.billboards, { gui = billboard, label = label, info = info })
    end
end

local function UpdateColors()
    for _, h in ipairs(ActiveESP.highlights) do
        h.FillColor = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
        h.OutlineColor = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
    end
    for _, b in ipairs(ActiveESP.billboards) do
        b.label.TextColor3 = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
    end
    for _, data in ipairs(ActiveESP.boxes) do
        if data.info and data.info.type == "monster" then
            data.box.Color3 = CONFIG.MONSTER_COLOR
        else
            data.box.Color3 = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
        end
    end
end

local function UpdateLabels()
    for _, b in ipairs(ActiveESP.billboards) do
        if b.info.type == "code" then b.label.Text = getLoc("code")
        elseif b.info.type == "spawn" then b.label.Text = getLoc("spawn")
        elseif b.info.type == "key" then b.label.Text = getLoc("key") .. " " .. b.info.id end
    end
end

local function UpdateTextVisibility()
    for _, b in ipairs(ActiveESP.billboards) do
        if b.info.type == "spawn" then
            b.gui.Enabled = true
        else
            b.gui.Enabled = CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT
        end
    end
end

local function ScanESP()
    ClearAllESP()
    if not CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED then return end

    local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "CodeNote" then CreateHighlightESP(obj, {type = "code"}) end
    end

    for i = 1, 4 do
        local keyObj = workspace:FindFirstChild("HiddenKey" .. i, true)
        if keyObj then
            local target = keyObj
            if keyObj:IsA("Folder") then
                target = keyObj:FindFirstChild("Key") or keyObj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            end
            
            if target and (target:IsA("Model") or target:IsA("BasePart")) then
                CreateBoxESP(target, {type = "key", id = i})
            end
        end
    end

    local spawnMarker = workspace:FindFirstChild("MonochromeESP_SpawnMarker")
    if not spawnMarker then
        spawnMarker = Instance.new("Part")
        spawnMarker.Name = "MonochromeESP_SpawnMarker"
        spawnMarker.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        spawnMarker.Position = CONFIG.KEY_SPAWN_POSITION
        spawnMarker.Anchored = true
        spawnMarker.CanCollide = false
        spawnMarker.Transparency = 0.8
        spawnMarker.Color = CONFIG.ESP_COLOR
        spawnMarker.Parent = workspace
    end
    CreateHighlightESP(spawnMarker, {type = "spawn"})

    if CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED then
        local monster = workspace:FindFirstChild("VER")
        if monster then CreateBoxESP(monster, {type = "monster"}) end
    end
end

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED = not CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED
    ToggleBtn.Text = CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED and getLoc("toggle") or getLoc("toggle_off")
    ScanESP()
end)

MonsterBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED = not CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED
    MonsterBtn.Text = CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED and getLoc("monster") or getLoc("monster_off")
    ScanESP()
end)

ColorBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local colors = {Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0), Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0), Color3.fromRGB(0,0,255), Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0), Color3.fromRGB(255,0,255)}
    local current = 1
    for i, c in ipairs(colors) do if c == CONFIG.ESP_COLOR then current = i break end end
    CONFIG.ESP_COLOR = colors[(current % #colors) + 1]
    UpdateColors()
end)

TextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT = not CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT
    TextBtn.Text = CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT and getLoc("text_on") or getLoc("text_off")
    UpdateTextVisibility()
end)

LangBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    LangMenu.Visible = not LangMenu.Visible
end)

MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = false
    LangMenu.Visible = false
    MiniBtn.Visible = true
end)

MiniBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = true
    MiniBtn.Visible = false
end)

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = false
    LangMenu.Visible = false
    MiniBtn.Visible = false
end)

RU_Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.LANGUAGE = "RU"
    Title.Text = getLoc("title")
    ToggleBtn.Text = CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED and getLoc("toggle") or getLoc("toggle_off")
    MonsterBtn.Text = CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED and getLoc("monster") or getLoc("monster_off")
    ColorBtn.Text = getLoc("color")
    TextBtn.Text = CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT and getLoc("text_on") or getLoc("text_off")
    LangBtn.Text = getLoc("lang")
    UpdateLabels()
    LangMenu.Visible = false
end)

EN_Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.LANGUAGE = "EN"
    Title.Text = getLoc("title")
    ToggleBtn.Text = CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED and getLoc("toggle") or getLoc("toggle_off")
    MonsterBtn.Text = CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED and getLoc("monster") or getLoc("monster_off")
    ColorBtn.Text = getLoc("color")
    TextBtn.Text = CONFIG.SHOW_TEXT and getLoc("text_on") or getLoc("text_off")
    LangBtn.Text = getLoc("lang")
    UpdateLabels()
    LangMenu.Visible = false
end)

ScanESP()

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(2)
        if CONFIG.ESP_ENABLED and CONFIG.MONSTER_ESP_ENABLED then
            local monster = game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("VER")
            if monster then
                local hasBox = false
                for _, data in ipairs(ActiveESP.boxes) do
                    if data.box and data.box.Adornee == monster then hasBox = true break end
                end
                if not hasBox then CreateBoxESP(monster, {type = "monster"}) end
            end
        end
    end
end)
